name: format
signature: format(Value: number | date | time | datetime, Format: text): text

params.name: Value
params.doc: Value to convert.

params.name: Format
params.doc: Format text; the value is converted according to this format. If omitted, Windows regional settings of the agent workstation are used.

doc: Converts a Value of type number, date, time, or datetime to text according to the Windows regional settings of the agent workstation, or according to the format Format.
webNotes: ASL Web Edition: the Agent Portal uses the format settings of the web server.

name: number_ceiling
doc: Returns the smallest integer not less than original_number. For example, number_ceiling(3.4) returns 4.

name: number_floor
doc: Returns the largest integer not greater than original_number. For example, number_floor(3.4) returns 3.

name: number_hex
doc: Returns the hexadecimal representation of original_number. For example, number_hex(10) returns "A".

name: number_mod
doc: Returns the remainder (modulo) of dividing number_dividend by number_divisor. For example, number_mod(7,2) returns 1.

name: number_round
doc: Returns original_number with nr_decimal_places number of decimal places. For example, number_round(10.26,1) returns 10.3.

name: text_to_upper
doc: Returns the textual value Text converted to uppercase.

name: text_to_lower
doc: Returns the textual value Text converted to lowercase.

name: text_length
doc: Returns the number of characters of the textual parameter. For example, text_length('abc') returns 3.

name: text_append
doc: Returns the concatenation of the textual values first_text and second_text. For example, text_append('abc','cba') returns 'abccba'. Text literals and FIBs placed together are also concatenated.

name: text_find
signature: text_find(original_text: text, pattern: text, case_sensitive: boolean, starting_index: number): number

params.name: original_text
params.doc: Text to search inside.

params.name: pattern
params.doc: Pattern text expression to search for.

params.name: case_sensitive
params.doc: Optional. Specifies if pattern search is case sensitive. The default value is true.

params.name: starting_index
params.doc: Optional. Specifies the starting position for pattern search. The first character has position 1, which is the default value.

doc: Searches for a pattern string inside a given text, returning the character position of the first occurrence, or zero if the pattern is not a substring of the text. For example, text_find('abbacacbc','ba') returns 3.

name: text_find_regex
signature: text_find_regex(original_text: text, pattern: text, case_sensitive: boolean, starting_index: number): number

params.name: original_text
params.doc: Text to search inside.

params.name: pattern
params.doc: Pattern text expression to search for.

params.name: case_sensitive
params.doc: Optional. Specifies if pattern search is case sensitive. The default value is true.

params.name: starting_index
params.doc: Optional. Specifies the starting position for pattern search. The first character has position 1, which is the default value.

doc: Searches for a regular expression inside a given text, returning the position of the 1st occurrence, or zero if the pattern is not a substring of the text. For example, text_find_regex('abbacacbc','b(.*)c') returns 3.

name: text_extract
signature: text_extract(original_text: text, starting_index: number, end_index: number): text

params.name: original_text
params.doc: Initial text.

params.name: starting_index
params.doc: First position of the substring on original_text. The first character has position 1. A non-positive starting position also represents the first character.

params.name: end_index
params.doc: Optional. Last position of the substring on original_text. The default value is Text length. Every bigger position also represents the last character.

doc: Returns a text substring. Returns the empty string if the ending position is smaller than the starting position.

name: text_replace
signature: text_replace(original_text: text, previous_text: text, new_text: text, case_sensitive: boolean, starting_index: number): text

params.name: original_text
params.doc: Text to search inside and replace.

params.name: previous_text
params.doc: Pattern text expression to replace inside Text.

params.name: new_text
params.doc: Replacing substring inside Text.

params.name: case_sensitive
params.doc: Optional. Specifies if pattern search is case sensitive. The default value is true.

params.name: starting_index
params.doc: Optional. Specifies the starting position for pattern search. The first character has position 1, which is the default value. A non-positive starting position also represents the first character.

doc: Returns a given text with all the occurrences of some substring starting from a specific position replaced by another substring. For example, text_replace('abc','b','g') returns 'agc'.

name: text_replace_regex
signature: text_replace_regex(original_text: text, pattern: text, new_text: text, case_sensitive: boolean, starting_index: number): text

params.name: original_text
params.doc: Text to search inside and replace.

params.name: pattern
params.doc: Pattern text expression to replace inside original_text.

params.name: new_text
params.doc: Replacing substring inside original_text.

params.name: case_sensitive
params.doc: Optional. Specifies if pattern search is case sensitive. The default value is true.

params.name: starting_index
params.doc: Optional. Specifies the starting position for pattern search. The first character has position 1, which is the default value. A non-positive starting position also represents the first character.

doc: Returns a given text with all the occurrences of a regular expression starting from a specific position replaced by a substring. For example, text_replace_regex('abcdef','b(.*)d','ggg') returns 'agggef'.

name: text_trim

params.name: position
params.doc: Optional. Default is TrimPosition::trimAll.

doc: Removes leading or training white spaces from original_text according to the optional position. The default value for the position is TrimPosition::trimAll. For example, text_trim(' aa ') returns 'aa'.

name: text_split
signature: text_split(original_text: text, delimiter: text): array of text

params.name: delimiter
params.doc: String used as separator.

doc: Splits original_text using the string delimiter as separator. For example, text_split('a|b|c','|') returns an array with 'a', 'b' and 'c'.

name: text_to_bytestream
doc: Converts text string Text into a byte stream using the encoding TextEncoding.

name: bytestream_to_text
doc: Converts byte stream Bytes to text using the encoding TextEncoding.

name: today
doc: Retrieves the current date from the Altitude uCI Server clock.

name: now
doc: Retrieves the current time from the Altitude uCI Server clock.
webNotes: ASL Web Edition (Agent Portal): returns the current date and time on the web server.

name: date
signature: date(y: number, m: number, d: number): date

params.name: y
params.doc: Year.

params.name: m
params.doc: Month.

params.name: d
params.doc: Day.

doc: Returns a date value, given the year, month and day.

name: time
signature: time(h: number, m: number, s: number): time

params.name: h
params.doc: Hours.

params.name: m
params.doc: Minutes.

params.name: s
params.doc: Optional. Seconds.

doc: Returns a time value, given the hours, minutes, and optionally seconds.

name: datetime
signature: datetime(y: number, M: number, d: number, h: number, m: number, s: number): datetime

params.name: y
params.doc: Year.

params.name: M
params.doc: Month.

params.name: d
params.doc: Day.

params.name: h
params.doc: Optional. Hours. Default 0.

params.name: m
params.doc: Optional. Minutes. Default 0.

params.name: s
params.doc: Optional. Seconds. Default 0.

doc: Returns a datetime value given the year, month, day, and optionally hours, minutes and seconds. The default value of the optional parameters is 0.

name: year
doc: Returns the year (0...9999) of the datetime dt.

name: month
doc: Returns the month (1...12) of the datetime dt.

name: day
doc: Returns the day (1...31) of the datetime dt.

name: hour
doc: Returns the hours (0...23) of the time value tm.

name: minute
doc: Returns the minutes (0...59) of the time value tm.

name: second
doc: Returns the seconds (0...59) of the time value tm.

name: week_day
doc: Returns the week day of the date Date as a text value, according to the Windows regional settings. English uses the values Monday, Tuesday, ...

name: nyears
doc: Returns the number of years between the two dates. If the first date is later than the second, the returned number is negative.

name: nmonths
doc: Returns the number of months between the two dates. If the first date is later than the second, the returned number is negative.

name: local_to_time_zone

params.name: Timezone
params.doc: Timezone name defined in Management Portal.

doc: Returns a datetime converted from the contact center timezone to a given timezone. Timezones are defined in Management Portal.

name: time_zone_to_local

params.name: Timezone
params.doc: Timezone name defined in Management Portal.

doc: Returns a datetime converted from a given timezone to the contact center timezone. Timezones are defined in Management Portal.

name: if
signature: if(Cond: boolean, Then: Type, Else: Type): Type

params.name: Then
params.doc: Returned if Cond is true.

params.name: Else
params.doc: Returned otherwise. Must have the same type as Then.

doc: If the condition Cond is true, returns Then. Otherwise, returns Else. Only the selected branch is evaluated, so the other cannot raise errors (e.g. division by zero).

name: full_node_name

params.name: NameSpace
params.doc: Optional. Namespace the path is relative to.

doc: Returns the namespace path of node NodeName on the current namespace, or optionally the path relative to the given namespace NameSpace.

name: linked_exit_point
doc: Returns true if the exit point ExitPointName of a node template is linked to another node on the flow editor.

name: size
doc: Returns the current number of elements in the array Array.

name: number_array

params.name: Number
params.doc: Values passed as arguments (one or more, comma separated).

doc: Returns an array of the number values passed as arguments. For example, number_array(1,3,5) returns an array with the three numbers 1, 3 and 5.

name: text_array

params.name: Text
params.doc: Values passed as arguments (one or more, comma separated).

doc: Returns an array of the text values passed as arguments.

name: boolean_array

params.name: Boolean
params.doc: Values passed as arguments (one or more, comma separated).

doc: Returns an array of the boolean values passed as arguments.

name: date_array

params.name: Date
params.doc: Values passed as arguments (one or more, comma separated).

doc: Returns an array of the date values passed as arguments.

name: time_array

params.name: Time
params.doc: Values passed as arguments (one or more, comma separated).

doc: Returns an array of the time values passed as arguments.

name: datetime_array

params.name: Datetime
params.doc: Values passed as arguments (one or more, comma separated).

doc: Returns an array of the datetime values passed as arguments.

name: build_sql_contains
signature: build_sql_contains(Column: text, Operator: SqlContainsOperator, FilterText: TEXT): text

params.name: Column
params.doc: Name of the database table column where the textual search will be performed. The specified column must full-text indexed.

params.name: Operator
params.doc: Specifies an exact match query, or a boolean operator to combine the search terms of the filter text: allWords, anyWord or exactMatch.

params.name: FilterText
params.doc: Text expression to search for, or multiple terms that will be combined using a boolean operator.

doc: Returns a textual value containing a SQL CONTAINS predicate to build full-text database queries.

name: file_create
signature: file_create(filename: text, permission_mode: FileAccessMode, share_mode: FileShareMode): number

params.name: filename
params.doc: Path name of the new file.

params.name: permission_mode
params.doc: Access permissions of the script over the file.

params.name: share_mode
params.doc: Access permissions of other applications over the file while it is open on the script.

doc: Returns a file handle for a new text file that is created and open. Sets @error if the file already exists.
webNotes: ASL Web Edition: the Agent Portal uses NETWORK_SERVICE security settings to execute file built-ins on the web server.

name: file_open
signature: file_open(filename: text, permission_mode: FileAccessMode, share_mode: FileShareMode): number

params.name: filename
params.doc: Path name of the file.

params.name: permission_mode
params.doc: Access permissions of the script over the file.

params.name: share_mode
params.doc: Access permissions of other applications over the file while it is open on the script.

doc: Returns a file handle for a specified file that is open. Sets @error if the file does not exist.
webNotes: ASL Web Edition: the Agent Portal uses NETWORK_SERVICE security settings to execute file built-ins on the web server.

name: file_delete
doc: Returns true if the file with path name filename is deleted. Sets @error if the file does not exist.
webNotes: ASL Web Edition: the Agent Portal uses NETWORK_SERVICE security settings to execute file built-ins on the web server.

name: file_exists
doc: Returns true if the file with path name filename exists on disk.
webNotes: ASL Web Edition: the Agent Portal uses NETWORK_SERVICE security settings to execute file built-ins on the web server.

name: file_datetime
doc: Returns the date and time of the last modification of the file with path name filename.
webNotes: ASL Web Edition: the Agent Portal uses NETWORK_SERVICE security settings to execute file built-ins on the web server.

name: file_split_path
doc: Returns a record with the drive letter, directory path, file name and file extension of the file file_path.
webNotes: ASL Web Edition: the Agent Portal uses NETWORK_SERVICE security settings to execute file built-ins on the web server.

name: file_make_path

params.name: file_path
params.doc: Record with fields driveLetter, dirPath, fileName, fileExtension (all text).

doc: Returns a textual representation of the path name file_path.
webNotes: ASL Web Edition: the Agent Portal uses NETWORK_SERVICE security settings to execute file built-ins on the web server.

name: file_close
doc: Returns true if the file with file handle file_handle is closed. Sets @error if the file handle is invalid.
webNotes: ASL Web Edition: the Agent Portal uses NETWORK_SERVICE security settings to execute file built-ins on the web server.

name: file_seek
signature: file_seek(file_handle: number, offset: number, position: SeekPosition): number

params.name: file_handle
params.doc: File handle of the file.

params.name: offset
params.doc: Number of characters to move the cursor. Negative numbers move the current position back, and positive numbers move the current position forward.

params.name: position
params.doc: Optional. Absolute position in the file to add the offset. The default is SeekPosition::current.

doc: Returns the new cursor position of a specified file, given an offset and a starting position. Sets @error if file_handle is not valid.
webNotes: ASL Web Edition: the Agent Portal uses NETWORK_SERVICE security settings to execute file built-ins on the web server.

name: file_read_line
doc: Returns the sequence of characters read from the file with file handle file_handle until finding end of line characters. Sets @error if the file handle is invalid, the file is not open for reading, or the end of the file is found.
webNotes: ASL Web Edition: the Agent Portal uses NETWORK_SERVICE security settings to execute file built-ins on the web server.

name: file_read

params.name: file_handle
params.doc: File handle of the file.

params.name: number_chars
params.doc: Optional. Number of characters to read from the file. The default is to read the entire file.

doc: Returns characters read from the file with the file handle file_handle until finding the end of file, or optionally a specified number of characters. Sets @error if the file handle is invalid, the file is not open for reading, or the end of the file is found.
webNotes: ASL Web Edition: the Agent Portal uses NETWORK_SERVICE security settings to execute file built-ins on the web server.

name: file_write
signature: file_write(file_handle: number, buffer: text, number_chars: number): number

params.name: file_handle
params.doc: Numeric file handle of the file.

params.name: buffer
params.doc: Text to write to the file.

params.name: number_chars
params.doc: Optional. Number of characters from the buffer to write to the file. The default is to write the entire buffer.

doc: Returns the number of characters written to a file. Sets @error if the file handle is invalid, the file is not open for writing, or there is not enough space on disk.
webNotes: ASL Web Edition: the Agent Portal uses NETWORK_SERVICE security settings to execute file built-ins on the web server.

name: file_write_line

params.name: file_handle
params.doc: File handle of the file.

params.name: buffer
params.doc: Text to write to the file.

doc: Returns true if the operation of writing text to a file succeeds. End-of-line characters are added to the file. Sets @error if the file handle is invalid, the file is not open for writing, or there is not enough space on disk.
webNotes: ASL Web Edition: the Agent Portal uses NETWORK_SERVICE security settings to execute file built-ins on the web server.

name: file_copy
signature: file_copy(source_filename: text, destination_filename: text, overwrite: boolean): boolean

params.name: source_filename
params.doc: Path name of the file to copy.

params.name: destination_filename
params.doc: Path name of the destination file. Creates the file if it does not exist.

params.name: overwrite
params.doc: If true, the destination file is overwritten if it already exists.

doc: Returns true if a file contents is copied to another file. Sets @error if the source file does not exist.
webNotes: ASL Web Edition: the Agent Portal uses NETWORK_SERVICE security settings to execute file built-ins on the web server.

name: folder_system_path

params.name: system_folder
params.doc: The system folder to look up.

doc: Returns the path of a system folder.
webNotes: ASL Web Edition: listed among the built-ins executed on the web server with NETWORK_SERVICE security settings.

name: tmp_filename

params.name: Directory
params.doc: Optional. The directory where the temporary file is searched for. The default value is the current working directory of uAgent Web or Automated Agents.

params.name: Prefix
params.doc: Optional. Prefix of the name of the temporary file. The default is the empty string.

doc: Returns the name of a temporary file.
webNotes: ASL Web Edition: the Agent Portal uses NETWORK_SERVICE security settings to execute file built-ins on the web server.

name: lookup
signature: lookup(File: text, Key: text, Value_col: number, Key_col: number, Separator: text): text

params.name: File
params.doc: Path name of the file.

params.name: Key
params.doc: Key value to look up for.

params.name: Value_col
params.doc: Optional. Number of the column to return on a match. By default, the second column.

params.name: Key_col
params.doc: Optional. Number of the column with the keys. By default, the first column.

params.name: Separator
params.doc: Optional. Character used as separator for the columns. By default, the vertical bar.

doc: Searches in a column of a table format text file for a key value and returns the cell contents on the same row and another column.
webNotes: ASL Web Edition: the Agent Portal uses NETWORK_SERVICE security settings to execute file built-ins on the web server.

name: current_email_id

params.name: WindowId
params.doc: Optional per docs wording ('optionally in the window WindowId').

doc: Only for uAgent scripts. Returns the email identifier of the email displayed on the email editor named EmailEditorName, optionally in the window WindowId.

name: selected_cursor_line

params.name: WindowId
params.doc: Optional per docs wording ('optionally in the window WindowId').

doc: Only for uAgent scripts. Returns the cursor position selected on the table named TableName, optionally in the window WindowId, or -1 if the table is empty.

name: rgb_color
signature: rgb_color(Red: number, Green: number, Blue: number): RGBColor

params.name: ColorName
params.doc: Name of the color (e.g. "Red", "AliceBlue"), or name of a component in the current Windows appearance scheme, like Active Border, Desktop or Menu Bar. Single-argument overload.

params.name: Red
params.doc: Red component, integer between 0 and 255. Three-argument overload.

params.name: Green
params.doc: Green component, integer between 0 and 255.

params.name: Blue
params.doc: Blue component, integer between 0 and 255.

overloads: rgb_color(Red: number, Green: number, Blue: number): RGBColor
doc: Only for uAgent scripts. Returns the color with the name ColorName or with the three RGB color components.

name: soft_phone_volume
doc: Only for uAgent scripts. Returns the current soft phone volume.

name: file_browser
signature: file_browser(initial_folder: text, extensions: text, dialog_title: text): text

params.name: initial_folder
params.doc: Optional. Initial directory of the browser window.

params.name: extensions
params.doc: Optional. List of valid file extensions separated by semicolons (;). The default is all files.

params.name: dialog_title
params.doc: Optional. Dialog title. The default is the system default.

overloads: file_browser(initial_folder: text, extensions: text, dialog_title: text): text
doc: For uAgent scripts. Returns a fake path. For example, c:\fakepath\<filename>.
webNotes: ASL Web Edition: the Agent Portal returns a fake path.

name: agents

params.name: Campaign
params.doc: Optional. Only agents assigned to this campaign.

doc: Returns the list of names of the agents configured on the Altitude uCI Server, or optionally only the agents that are assigned to the specified campaign.

name: campaigns
doc: Returns the list of campaign names of a session service.

name: custom_call_states
doc: Returns the list of custom call states defined in Management Portal.

name: GetDayTypeNames

params.name: date
params.doc: Optional. Date to find day types for; the docs show a call without arguments too.

doc: Returns the list of day types that include a given date. Documented as a .NET-style method call on session.Instance, assigned to `var dayTypes: System::String[]`.

name: last_called_agent

params.name: uniqueId
params.doc: Contact profile unique id.

doc: Returns the user name of the agent that handled the last interaction of the specified contact profile unique id.

name: medias
doc: Returns the list of the medias configured on the Altitude uCI Server.

name: outbound_rules
doc: Returns the list of outbound rule names.

name: phone_schedule_rules
doc: Returns the list of phone schedule rule names.

name: session_outcomes_history
doc: Returns the outcomes of a previous script session.

name: skill_profile
doc: Returns the skill profile with the name Name (an array of SkillProfileEntry).

name: skill_profile_info
doc: For IVR and routing scripts. Returns the information about agents working with skill profile SkillName in the campaign Campaign.

name: skill_profile_media_info
signature: skill_profile_media_info(Campaign: text, SkillName: text, MediaName: text): SkillProfileInfo

params.name: MediaName
params.doc: Media type name.

doc: For IVR and routing scripts. Returns the information about agents working with skill profile SkillName in the campaign Campaign, for the media type MediaName.

name: skill_profiles
doc: Returns the list of skill profile names.

name: time_zones
doc: Returns the list of time zone names.

name: workflow_definitions

params.name: Service
params.doc: Optional. Service name; default is the current service.

doc: Returns the list of all the workflow definition names for the current service, or optionally for the specified service.

name: queue_position
doc: Returns a value of type QueuePosition with routing information about the current interaction. Only applies to phone and instant messaging interactions.

name: whole

params.name: Format
params.doc: Optional. Auxiliary information for the DLL function, such as language, genre, or number.

doc: Returns the text that corresponds to reading out Exp as usual. For example, 11 may become eleven. Returns null if Exp cannot be converted to speech.

name: spell

params.name: Format
params.doc: Optional. Auxiliary information for the DLL function, such as language, genre, or number.

doc: Returns the text that corresponds to spelling out Exp. For example, 11 may become one one. Returns null if Exp cannot be converted to speech.

name: ordinal

params.name: Format
params.doc: Optional. Auxiliary information for the DLL function, such as language, genre, or number.

doc: Returns the text that corresponds to reading Exp as an ordinal. For example, 11 may become eleventh. Returns null if Exp cannot be converted to speech.

name: activity_schema
doc: Returns the attribute declaration for the activity table schema of the current campaign.

name: contact_profile_extension_schema
doc: Returns the attribute declaration for the extension of the specified directory.

name: agent_info
doc: Returns the state, skills, and interactions queued for the agent with short name Agent.

name: ani_lists

params.name: service
params.doc: If set, returns a list of names of Service ANI Lists for the specified service. Otherwise, returns a list of names of Service ANI Lists for the service of the campaign where the current session is running.

doc: Returns a list of names of Service ANI Lists for the specified service.

name: available_agents_info
signature: available_agents_info(logged: boolean, withExtension: boolean, userNameFilter: text, fullNameFilter: text, campaignsReady: array of text): array of AvailableAgentInfo

params.name: logged
params.doc: Optional. If true, the function only returns the information of logged agents. The default is true.

params.name: withExtension
params.doc: Optional. If true, the function only returns the information of agents with an extension. The default is true.

params.name: userNameFilter
params.doc: Optional. Text to search in the user names of the agents. The function only returns the information of agents that contain the text in the user name. The default is the empty string.

params.name: fullNameFilter
params.doc: Optional. Text to search in the full names of the agents. The function only returns the information of agents that contain the text in the full name. The default is the empty string.

params.name: campaignsReady
params.doc: Optional. Array containing names of campaigns. The function only returns the information of agents ready in all the specified campaigns. The default is an empty array.

doc: Returns the state of the agents working in the contact center.

name: email_message
doc: Returns the fields of an email stored in the document manager, as specified by the numeric identifier Email.

name: campaign_agents_info
doc: Returns the state of the agents in the campaign with the name Campaign. The agents must have the campaign open.

name: campaign_agents_media_info
signature: campaign_agents_media_info(Campaign: text, MediaName: text): array of CampaignAgentMediaInfo
doc: Returns information about all medias of all agents, for a given campaign and media name.

name: campaign_info
doc: Returns the number of agents and interactions in the campaign with the short name Campaign. In environments with a large usage of the function, consider using the built-in skill_profile_media_info.

name: campaign_schema
doc: Returns the attribute declaration for the campaign table schema of the current campaign.

name: document_info
doc: Returns information about the active revision of the document doc_id on the document manager. Optionally, specify a specific revision number rev_nr.

name: document_revisions
doc: Returns the list of revisions of the document doc_id on the document manager.

name: interaction_history_detail
doc: Returns information about an interaction with the ID interactionId returned by the system cursors contactProfileInteractionsHistory and contactProfileInteractionsWithOutcomesHistory.
